disease_label_per_paper: Aggressive atypical anti-GBM disease complicated by CMV pneumonitis
presentation_summary: 24-year-old man with smoking history presented with two weeks of leg edema, hemoptysis, nephrotic-range proteinuria, and acute renal failure.
Chest X-rays showed progressive bilateral patchy opacities and CT showed mild scattered patchy ground-glass opacities.
Creatinine was 346 umol/L at presentation and later peaked at 454 umol/L.
Linear IgG staining and negative serologies are preserved as confirmatory/context; later CMV pneumonitis is outcome/context not initial ranking.

risk_context.source_text_value: significant cigarette and marijuana smoking history

observations.source_text_value: mild scattered patchy ground-glass opacities bilaterally
two-week hemoptysis with bilateral opacities at initial presentation; later CMV pneumonitis relapse is excluded from this observation
serum creatinine 346 umol/L converted to 3.91 mg/dL
later became dialysis dependent after follow-up course; not an initial presentation ranking observation

confirmatory_findings.finding: Linear IgG staining on renal biopsy
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: direct IF showed strong linear staining for IgG along GBMs
readmitted one month later; BAL and blood confirmed CMV pneumonitis

notes: Linear IgG and serology are not ranked; later CMV pneumonitis is not initial presentation evidence.
Dyspnea was not explicitly reported at initial presentation, so no dyspnea ranking observation is used.
